## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Attach namespaced `origin` and `tool_call_id` metadata to `BackgroundTools` completions by @michaeldunn9 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10196
* Take GPT-Live realtime history, usage, and reply waits from the session core by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10083
* Honour `disable-model-invocation` and `user-invocable` in `Skills`, and skip stray skill library paths by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10378
* Take Gemini Live realtime history, usage, and reply waits from the session core by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10082
### 🚀 Features
* Add `MetaProvider` for Meta Muse models, with `meta:` using the Responses API by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10156
* Add Harness `ApprovalReviewer` to let a model approve low-risk tool calls before a person sees them by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10143
* Price requests at their reported service tier by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai
